body:
⚠️ **This post is the RECORD of state, not the state.** Every fire re-reads the labels. ⛔ Never read a count here as current.

📌 Job description: `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/services.md`. ⛔ Not hand-copied per term. Seat 1 is #6021.

## 1. Current PM — ⏳ vacant

- **Signed off 2026-10-14T03:18Z** on the maintainer's order in this session, verbatim: 「当前任务处理完，合并后就下班」. Holder was `zhuangjianguo` · `session_01FzQy26KznSa5j2gnf3AzsE`, seated 2026-10-12T14:15Z on `/pm-dispatch services seat 2`. The closing brief is the newest comment on this post, and it is the release marker.
- **Stay-behind:** none. Every claim of this session is landed, released or blocked with its `Blocked-by:` line. No ACCEPTed PR waits in a queue, and the wake Routine `trig_01K73x6CetyMmLq5g5BkarJS` was deleted at sign-off.
- **Posture at sign-off:** `batch:1` (serial), on the maintainer's order 「当前任务处理完，后续改为串行派发」. ⛔ Not inherited: a new holder starts from the default unless the maintainer restates it to their session (`seat-lifecycle.md`).
- **Write identity used:** the fleet relay (`objectstack-fleet[bot]`) via `scripts/pm/*`, selector `dispatch`.
- **To take the seat:** `/pm-dispatch services seat 2`, after reading this post and the closing brief.
- **Previous holders:** `zhuangjianguo` · `session_013LbZ9MhPp1iriZEtgJqioA` (signed off at brief `6116196991`), then this session.

## 2. Ledger (this session; each card's own comments are the record)

- **In flight:** none at sign-off.
- **Released:** #23152 (`6140134367`). The dev measured that every fix adds a member to `plugin-auth`'s exported `IdentityImportDeps` and `AuthManager`. That makes it `Clause-②: yes`, which is spec-lane work, so it is in `pm:retriage` with the seat's recommended route A (mirror the SMS invitation channel).
- **Released, round 9:** #23174 (`6143276509`). A measured leak in four families (share links joined as a row). No existing export carries the nested-envelope withholding, and triage forbade a per-arm copy, so the fix needs one new `@objectstack/types` writer: `Clause-②: yes`, spec lane. The seat's answers ride along: Q1 recommends B; Q2 excludes the authored crypto refusal; Q3 leaves the branded outage relays out.
- **Released, round 10:** #23233's remainder (`6146820974`), after its partial landing below. A host kernel still serves a runtime package's fresh `isDefault` set unowned until a list read: the producer is `metadata-protocol`'s write-through (`applyRegistryWriteThrough` → `hydrateOverlayIntoRegistry`), which is `domain:engine`'s. Into `pm:queue` + `pm:retriage` with p2 kept.
- **Verified, round 14:** #23256 (`6158817408`). The v18 ceremony attributes an upgraded holding, and the approval slate then reaches the holder. A fresh-install system insert of `sys_user_position` still stores NULL, because the assignment tables are unclassified in the #13491 ledger. That lift is C8's by ruling (#14570), so a family row went on #15212 (`6158806217`) and the card is `pm:blocked` on #15212. The seat's earlier code reading (census `reach: in` = D9 admission) was wrong, and the record says so.
- **Decision box round trip:** #23093 (round 3). The dev's report `6133252394` falsified the 17.7.0-regression premise (the 17.7.0 harness ran organization-less personas). The remaining question, whether the chain walk drops the platform ownership floor at a `controlled_by_parent` middle master, widens a permission boundary. Analysis `6133315184` (A / B / C, recommends A with explicit approval); labels `needs-user-decision` + `pm:retriage`; assignee cleared.
- **Landed:**
  - #23328 → PR #23369 (`28e294f450`; ACCEPT `6159844918`, landing note on the card). Both share-link resolve mounts answer an anonymous caller of a password-protected `signed_in` link with one `SIGN_IN_REQUIRED`, whatever password was sent: no password oracle.
  - #23226 (ADR-0138 E3) → PR #23353 (`e790cfc503`; seat answer `6158206845`, contract review PASS `6158454903`, ACCEPT `6158478554`, landing note `6158833755`). For the guest envelope the owner-anchor stamp writes nothing and refuses a guest-supplied owner whatever the guest holds. Before, a transfer-bit guest stored a forged owner.
  - #23284 → PR #23340 (`24e064fc94`; amendment `6155816752`, declared to `domain:engine` `6155826442`; contract review FAIL `6156230712`, then one patch round and PASS `6156956940`; ACCEPT `6156975620`, landing note `6157406914`). A notification carries the organization of what it is about. `sys_notification` joins the #13491 tenancy ledger, so an unattributable emit gets ADR-0131 D9's sole organization or a loud refusal, never NULL.
  - #23281 → PR #23318 (`6673c8018f`; amendment `6152677078`, one patch round, contract review PASS `6153659174`, ACCEPT `6153697508`, landing note `6154230310`). `os migrate comment-reactions` carries 17.x stored reactions into `sys_comment_reaction` records, and the destructive apply drops the column only after a verified run. Under `--json`, the account-issuer refusals now exit 1.
  - #23184, `plugin-auth` slice → PR #23300 (`9c7cfbf0a9`; amendment `6149582607`, ACCEPT `6149925053`, release `6150382419`). Five of the ten `plugin-auth` rows are under budget, through a per-file scrypt memo, once-per-file sign-ups and concurrent suites, with tests only and every assertion unchanged. The card is back in `pm:queue` for the remaining rows.
  - #23233, partial → PR #23258 (`09ef77c7d8`; ACCEPT `6146240773`, landing and release `6146820974`). On an environment kernel the permission-set echo carries `_packageId` from the protocol's by-name read, so an `isDefault` set in a runtime package records its everyone suggestion and both owner reads agree. The row keeps `managed_by: 'admin'`.
  - #23175 → PR #23237 (`6f4c518b01`; ACCEPT `6144021147`, landing note `6144481278`). The dev seed gives the workspace the host's zone through the settings door, so a fresh `os dev` database opens with no dialog.
  - #23184, `plugin-sharing` slice → PR #23243 (`4f5679c261`; ACCEPT `6144852121`, release `6145321551`). Both files are under budget, tests-only, with every assertion unchanged.
  - #23189 → PR #23203 (`917b1a0c7d`; contract review FAIL `6142025571` on semver, then round-2 PASS `6142710689`; ACCEPT `6142737368`, landing note `6143301419`). `IdentityObjectsPlugin` keeps the `single` Default Organization; `AppPlugin` orders it ahead of the inline seed. It unblocks cloud's v18 move after cloud's pin bump.
  - #23178, partial → PR #23200 (`08b38cb9d8`; contract review PASS `6142166159`, ACCEPT `6142187671`). Datasource admin, share links, webhook redeliver and storage refuse an ADR-0069-held session. The settings row was released to `pm:retriage` (`6142709445`, `Clause-②: yes`, spec lane).
  - #23157 → PR #23202 (`920bc12a24`; ACCEPT `6142261622`, landing note `6142810804`). All nine approval request actions name the request, and explain names the principal as a person.
  - #23143 → PR #23172 (`3d6392f1fa`; one patch round, ACCEPT `6139422583`, landing note `6139763371`). A refused presigned token answers `401 INVALID_TOKEN` on both raw byte routes; their 500 arm withholds the fault's text, and the signature compare is constant-time.
  - #23142 → PR #23171 (`20949e7a7c`; contract review PASS `6139053386`, ACCEPT `6139109957`, landing note `6139411461`). The settings REST family answers an anonymous caller with the shared 401 floor, mounted once. It was the fourth door blocking ADR-0138 criterion 2; a pointer went to #22146 (`6139415669`), whose unblock is its holder's.
  - #23124 → PR #23153 (`dc93781c19`; ruling A, contract review PASS `6138330704`, ACCEPT `6138341651`, landing note `6138611286`). The platform stamps `sys_comment` `is_edited` / `edited_at`; a client value is stripped or overwritten. The objectui half is the `domain:ui` seat's, after release.
  - #23122 → PR #23138 (`5d63c37c56`; the maintainer's queue-jump, ACCEPT `6137592480`, landing note `6137923453`). Both outboxes read their claim credential back from the store, so `ack()` lands on a legacy `real` column.
  - #23093 → PR #23114 (`dfb3ba2b23`; ruling A, ACCEPT `6136199706`, landing note `6136571896`). The chain walk judges a `controlled_by_parent` middle master by its own direct-write composition; PR #23091's pin flipped in the same PR.
  - #23054 → PR #23071 (`275ad4229a`; ACCEPT `6128342623`, landing note on the card). The organization seed claim pages its predicate write past the per-row hook ceiling.
- **Filed:**
  - #23174: the family card for the declared-5xx message-text leak across the service-storage, service-settings and service-i18n route handlers. Found while reviewing PR #23172; ungraded, for triage.
  - #23178: the ADR-0069 authentication-policy gate is never consulted by route families mounted straight on the host server. Security exception, measure reachability first. Found by PR #23171's contract review; graded p1 `security`.
  - #23190: the `domain:cli` half of the same family (REST's direct-mount registrars, the runtime declared-endpoint fallback, which served a write, and cloud-connection's raw-app plugins). Measured by #23178's dev; ungraded, for triage.
  - #23259: a body `packageId` on a permission-set publish is accepted and then overridden by the served package binding (class c; the named producer is cloud's AI build). Found reviewing PR #23258; ungraded, for triage.
  - #23354: the seed-settle claim hands unowned guest and form rows to the platform admin on every `app:seeded`, against ADR-0138 D1. Found by #23226's dev; triage graded it p2 `target:v18` `domain:services`. It also carries the ADR-0138 anchor for `security-plugin.ts` (`6158485388`).
  - #23359: when the security plugin is not composed, `os migrate organization-ownership --apply` blocks on shipped permission sets and prescribes removing the admin's grants. Found by #23256's verification; ungraded, for triage.
  - #23371: the two mounts of the share-link messages door disagree for a signed-in caller of a `signed_in` conversation link (404 vs 200). Triaged p2 into this lane.
  - #23372: an email-audience share link answers an anonymous caller holding the correct password with the wrong-password code. Reordering needs a decision (allowlist-membership oracle). Triaged p3 `security` into this lane.
- **Lane snapshot at sign-off** (2026-10-14T03:18Z; read fresh at every pick, never from here):
  - `pm:queue`:
    - #23371 (p2): the share-link messages door's two mounts disagree for a signed-in caller (404 vs 200). Filed by this seat at #23328's ACCEPT.
    - #23372 (p3 `security`): an email-audience share link's refusal order. The seat filed it as needing a decision (allowlist-membership oracle), so read it for escalation before any dispatch.
    - #23354 (p2): the seed-settle claim against ADR-0138 D1. The seat's lean is A, narrowing the claim to seed rows. Its PR also carries the ADR-0138 anchor for `security-plugin.ts` (`6158485388`).
    - #23343 (p2): an imported user is invited with password-reset copy. Unread by this seat; the imported-user family is #23152, which is in the spec lane.
    - #23325 (p3): the record-share refusal text. Triage's direction fixes the refusal message only, not an access widening.
    - #23279 (p3): the activity feed's denial WARN flood.
    - #23184 (p3): the remaining test-budget rows. `plugin-auth` has five, with diagnoses in `6150382419`; `plugin-security`, `service-datasource` and `organizations` have two each.
    - #8998: the coordination node.
  - `pm:dispatched`: #15204 (the epic, `marchtian`, ⛔ not this seat's).
  - `pm:blocked`, every blocker read open at sign-off:
    - #23256 on #15212 (C8). Restart: re-run verification 2.
    - #22590 on #22788.
    - #15086 on #15211.
    - #22269 on objectstack-ai/objectui#11958.
  - `pm:on-hold`: #20645, #20178, #10757 and #1883, each with its own `Restart-when:`.
  - Decision box: empty (`needs-user-decision`: none in this lane).
  - Tracking: #12150 and #5266 (no `pm:*` state); #11633 (`pm:blocking`).
- **Carried from the previous holder:** #22590. When #22788 closes, verify the two pins on `main` and close it. Seat 1 signed off (brief `6127166372`), so this seat holds the follow-up alone.
- **Follow-up on #23256:** when #22937 lands, verify on `main` that the ceremony stamps an organization-less `sys_user_position` row and the slate reaches the holder, and that a fresh `single` install's system insert stores the Default Organization. Both hold ⇒ close completed by #22937; either fails ⇒ file to the upgrade plan's or the producer's lane.
- **Routed out:** #22871 to the spec lane (triage `6137138392`, answering this seat's `pm:retriage` `6136747056`).
- **Decision box:** #23124 answered A (`6137155820`), landed. #23093 answered A (`6133922339` / `6134050293`); triage re-graded it p1 with `target:v18` off (`6133394280`). #22915 (the ADR-0087 disposition gap) is open and `domain:devx`'s to execute. #23256 (p1 `target:v18`) was answered in session: no compatibility reading on the approval slate, and the v18 upgrade attributes the holdings (ruling record `6147914816`, verbatim 「所有有问题也应该是优化升级方案」). It went `needs-user-decision` → `pm:blocked` on #22937 (C7b; pointer `6147942984`).

## 3. Hot-file serial queue

- **`packages/plugins/organizations/src/claim-org-seed-ownership.ts`:** #23008 (`e49aaec73`) and #23054 (`275ad4229a`) landed; nothing in flight on it.
- **`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin.ts`:** #23093 (`dfb3ba2b23`), E1 (`37510aa0f9`, engine seat 1), #23308 (engine seat 2) and E3 #23226 (`e790cfc503`) landed. Nothing of this seat's is in flight. #23354 (queued) will touch `claim-seed-ownership.ts` and the settle hook here.
- **`packages/services/service-messaging/src/sql-outbox.ts` and `sql-http-outbox.ts`:** #23122 landed (`5d63c37c56`); nothing in flight on them.

- **`service-automation/src/builtin/notify-node.ts`, the `service-messaging` emit write path, `plugin-approvals/src/approval-service.ts` and the `sys_notification` row of `objectql/src/tenancy/platform-object-tenancy.ts`:** #23284 landed (`24e064fc94`); nothing in flight.
- **`packages/services/service-settings/src/settings-routes.ts`, `service-storage/src/storage-routes.ts` and `service-i18n/src/i18n-service-plugin.ts`:** #23142 (`20949e7a7c`), #23143 (`3d6392f1fa`) and #23178's partial (`08b38cb9d8`) landed. The #23178 settings row and #23174 are both in `pm:retriage` for the spec lane. Nothing of this seat's is in flight on them.
- **`packages/services/service-datasource/src/admin-routes.ts`, `packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/share-link-routes.ts` and `runtime/src/domains/share-links.ts`:** #23178's partial (`08b38cb9d8`) and #23328 (`28e294f450`) landed; nothing in flight. #23371 and #23372, both ungraded, would touch the share-link routes next.
- **`plugin-auth`:** #23189 (`917b1a0c7d`), #23175 (`6f4c518b01`) and the #23184 slice (`9c7cfbf0a9`, test files plus `src/__tests__/scrypt-memo.testkit.ts`) landed. Nothing in flight.

- **`packages/plugins/plugin-webhooks/src/webhook-outbox-plugin.ts`:** #23178's partial landed (`08b38cb9d8`); nothing in flight.
- **`plugin-approvals/src/sys-approval-request.object.ts` and `plugin-security/src/explain-engine.ts` (the principal layer's sentence only):** #23157 landed (`920bc12a24`); nothing in flight.
- Seat 1's post (#6021, section 3) holds the lane's region-level rows, including the C2/C3 cutover epic's territory in `plugin-security`, `plugin-sharing` and `plugin-auth`. This seat reads them at every pick. A claim of this seat in that territory declares on #15194 first.
